key_features: KEEP YOUR OVEN CLEAN: Protect your oven floor against those annoying spills on the bottom of your electric or gas oven. Our oven liners are built to keep your oven in pristine condition and protect it against spills, drips, gunk and food getting stuck on the bottom of your oven. They also function as an oven mat for bottom of oven, providing ultimate coverage for electric and gas ovens

SAVE TIME CLEANING: Put an end to scrubbing the bottom of your oven floor. Our washable heavy duty and non-stick oven liners mats save you time and energy and are easy to clean - simply wipe down using a damp cloth or place in the top shelf of your dishwasher, then reuse as normal. You can also use these liners as an oven cover for hassle-free cleanup

MULTI FUNCTIONAL: Works as a bbq grill mat, baking mat, oven liner and pan liner - the uses are endless. They also act as drip pan trays for cooking and baking - protecting your oven floor no matter the case. Our double sided oven liners are a must have cooking accessory for any kitchen

SUPERIOR QUALITY: Withstands up to 500°F and is 100% BPA Free and PFOA Free. Each oven floor protector liner is made from a durable, heat-resistant coating, reinforced with fiberglass fabric. Each pack comes with 3 oven liners measuring 16.25” by 23”, with a thickness of 0.2mm, providing you with an extra-thick durable product that covers your entire bottom oven. Easily cut to size using scissors to fit your oven

PROPER INSTALLATION IS KEY: Everyone’s oven is different. In all ovens with hidden heating elements, the oven mat needs to be placed on the lowest rack (not on the oven bottom). For ovens with exposed heating elements, place liner under the heating element at the bottom of the oven floor
